content.short: Mint, buy and sell NFTs on Ethereum, Polygon and other chains through Rarible, a marketplace founded in 2020.
content.description: Rarible was one of the first open NFT marketplaces where anyone could mint their own work. Today it covers Ethereum, Polygon and other networks, rewards active traders, and lets communities set up branded storefronts. The Rarible Protocol and its multichain SDK, listed separately, let developers mint NFTs, post orders and fill trades in their own apps. Orders are shared across marketplaces built on the same protocol. Alex Salnikov co-founded it in 2020, and the platform has since added Solana alongside its EVM networks.
content.meta: Multichain NFT marketplace for minting and trading collectibles, with trader rewards. Explore Rarible on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
